newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Angry Albanians burn town hall as protest grows.
newsitem.headline: Angry Albanians burn town hall as protest grows.

text.p: Angry Albanian demonstrators set fire to buildings in the southern town of Berat on Saturday as protests over collapsing pyramid investment schemes intensified, Albanian television reported.
Television did not say what type of buildings had been set ablaze, but one resident in the town told Reuters by telephone the town hall, the prefecture and a police station were on fire.
"I am sorry for the policemen. They are beating them up. They have also taken the police chief hostage," a woman who witnessed the scene said by telephone.

She said thousands had gathered at the police station in Berat, 120 km (80 miles) south of Tirana, and a police helicopter was flying over but unable to land. Prisoners in the police station were released or fled when the fire grew.
The crowd chanted "Down with the thieves!", "They have to give us our money back!" .
Protests have spread across the Balkan state over the past two weeks as growing numbers of investors, afraid of losing all their wealth invested in dubious pyramid schemes, have taken to the streets.
